title: Option to seek forwards/backwards rather than changing volume upon mouse wheel scrolling on applet
line: The Media Player widget has a new setting to make scrolling over it seek backward and forward instead of changing the volume.
explanation: Scrolling over the Media Player widget (in the tray or on a panel) always called changeVolume() on the player, and the widget had no settings page at all: main.qml even removed its configure action, so there was no way to choose anything else. Users who mostly listen to long tracks or streams wanted scrolling to jump back and forth instead. The change adds a General settings page with a 'Scrolling over the widget' choice (Adjusts volume, the default, or Seeks backward and forward); with seeking on, each wheel notch calls the player's MPRIS Seek by ±5 seconds (the same step as the arrow keys in the popup) and the tooltip says 'Scroll to seek'.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: add an option to seek when scrolling

Scrolling over the Media Player widget could only change the volume,
while seeking is often more useful when listening to long tracks. Add a
settings page where scrolling can be set to seek by 5 seconds instead.

BUG: 405096

Subject: [PATCH] applets/mediacontroller: add an option to seek when scrolling

Scrolling over the Media Player widget could only change the volume,
while seeking is often more useful when listening to long tracks. Add a
settings page where scrolling can be set to seek by 5 seconds instead.

BUG: 405096

@@ -84,11 +84,23 @@ Loader {
             wheelDelta += (wheel.inverted ? -1 : 1) * (wheel.angleDelta.y ? wheel.angleDelta.y : -wheel.angleDelta.x)
             while (wheelDelta >= 120) {
                 wheelDelta -= 120;
-                mpris2Model.currentPlayer.changeVolume(root.volumePercentStep / 100, true);
+                if (Plasmoid.configuration.scrollToSeek) {
+                    if (root.canSeek) {
+                        mpris2Model.currentPlayer.Seek(5000000); // microseconds
+                    }
+                } else {

+                }
             }
             while (wheelDelta <= -120) {
                 wheelDelta += 120;
-                mpris2Model.currentPlayer.changeVolume(-root.volumePercentStep / 100, true);
+                if (Plasmoid.configuration.scrollToSeek) {
+                    if (root.canSeek) {
+                        mpris2Model.currentPlayer.Seek(-5000000);
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    mpris2Model.currentPlayer.changeVolume(-root.volumePercentStep / 100, true);
+                }
             }
         }
         onClicked: (mouse) => {

+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>

+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2

+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
+
+KCM.SimpleKCM {

media.caption: Master: the Media Player popup has no settings button, so nothing about scrolling can be changed.
With the fix the popup header has a settings button.
Master: scrolling over the tray icon always changes the player's volume (OSD at 65%); tooltip says 'Scroll to adjust volume'.
With 'Seeks backward and forward' chosen, scrolling seeks the track instead (no volume OSD) and the tooltip says 'Scroll to seek'.
The new settings page: Scrolling over the widget: Adjusts volume (default) / Seeks backward and forward.
